verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents an official MCP server (semgrep-probe-3) that lets agents connect via `uvx semgrep-mcp`, but a hands-on handshake test failed to initialize despite semgrep being on PATH (semgrep-probe-6), and both pieces of evidence come from the same 'probe' tier so this cannot be called a cross-tier dispute. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of successful MCP usage, and a reproducible successful handshake to resolve the observed failure.
